name: Prom
payout: Fanciest is crowned Prom King/Queen: 5. 2nd Fanciest: 2.
story: The crown goes to whoever looks most like royalty.

name: Student Council Election
story: Nobody reads the platforms; everyone votes for the most likable face.

name: Homecoming Court
story: Royalty needs a crown and a smile.

name: School Picture Day
story: The yearbook gives last place the Most Memorable award.
notes: At 2 players: Cutest 4, the other player 3.

name: Field Trip
story: The wackiest kid spends the trip on the bus.
notes: At 2 players: the less Wacky player scores 3.

name: Talent Show
story: The most boring act goes viral.
notes: If 3 or more players tie for least, they each score 2.

name: Battle of the Bands
story: Glam rock: rhinestones and rubber chickens.

name: Fall Fling
payout: Everyone scores 1 Like for every 3 Wacky, up to 3.
story: It's just a dance; everyone busts out their silliest moves and posts the video.

name: Yearbook Superlatives
payout: Wackiest is Class Clown: 4. Spookiest is Most Likely to Haunt the School: 4.
story: Two awards nobody campaigns for.

name: Detention
story: Rebels get respect; teacher's pets don't.

name: Up for a Promotion
story: Dress for the job you want, not the circus you want.

name: Job Interview
payout: Everyone with 6+ Fancy is hired: 2. Fanciest also gets the corner office: 2 more.
story: Nobody checked the resumes.

name: Meeting the In-Laws
story: They want someone sweet, not someone who brought a bat.

name: Baby Shower
story: The cutest guest ends up in all the baby photos.

name: Wedding
story: Never upstage the couple.
notes: At 2 players: the less Fancy player scores 3.

name: Reading of the Will
payout: Fanciest inherits the company: 4. Spookiest inherits the haunted mansion: 4.
story: Great-aunt had two kinds of heirs in mind.

name: Family Photo Day
payout: Out-Cute the player on your right: 3.
story: Grandma is comparing.

name: Kid's Birthday Party
payout: Everyone with 6+ Wacky: 2. Wackiest also gets booked for next year: 2 more.
story: The kids decide who's fun.

name: 21st Birthday
story: Last place is the designated driver, and everyone loves them for it.
notes: At 2 players: Wackiest 4, the other player 3.

name: Halloween Costume Contest
story: Scary, funny, or both.

name: New Year's Eve
payout: Fanciest gets the VIP table: 4. Wackiest leads the countdown: 4.
story: Two ways to own midnight.

name: Turkey Trot
payout: Everyone scores 1 Like for every 3 Cute, up to 3.
story: Nobody's racing; everyone's posting.

name: Ugly Sweater Party
story: Trying to look nice is the one way to lose.

name: Haunted House Tour
story: The staff think the spookiest guest works there; the least spooky guest's scream goes viral.
notes: If 3 or more players tie for least, they each score 2.

name: Beach Day
payout: Out-Cute the player on your left: 3.
story: Sun hats and sandcastles: everyone's comparing towels.

name: Fancy Restaurant
payout: Everyone with 5+ Fancy gets seated: 3. Fanciest scores 0 instead.
story: The fanciest-looking guest gets stuck with the bill.

name: Camping Trip
story: Best campfire ghost story wins.

name: Sleepover
story: Ghost stories in onesies.

name: Art Gallery Opening
story: The spookiest guest's portrait gets hung in the gallery.

name: Goth Concert
story: The band spots you from the stage.

name: Midnight Movie Marathon
payout: Everyone with 6+ Spooky: 2. Spookiest also gets the best seat: 2 more.
story: Only the truly creepy make it to the end.

name: Vampire Ball
story: Velvet, candlelight, and very pointy teeth.

name: First Date
story: Don't try too hard.
notes: At 2 players: the less Cute player scores 3.

name: Red Carpet Premiere
story: Least Fancy tops the worst-dressed list, and that's still press.
notes: If 3 or more players tie for least, they each score 1.

name: Circus Audition
story: There's only one opening.

name: Pet Adoption Day
story: The puppy picks the cutest person in the room.

name: Mystery Dinner Party
story: The spookiest guest obviously did it.
notes: At 2 players: the less Spooky player scores 3.
